title: DoppelVet: Comparative Safety Verification for Self-Evolving Agents
title_zh: DoppelVet：面向自演化智能体的对比式安全验证
abstract_en: Self-evolving agents improve by retaining feedback as reusable memories or skills, but every mistaken approval can shape many future behaviors. Two updates can provide exactly the same evidence to a verifier yet produce opposite safety outcomes, so the verifier cannot distinguish them from that evidence alone. We introduce DoppelVet, a verification framework that checks proposed updates before they enter an agent's persistent state. Without access to safety labels, DoppelVet constructs an alternative that matches every signal used by the existing verifier. It replays both updates from the same state and directly compares their behaviors in both presentation orders before deciding whether to retain the candidate. We evaluate DoppelVet on DoppelVet-Grid and DoppelVet-Tool, covering executable programs and natural-language memories. Across nine open-weight and proprietary verifiers, DoppelVet raises mean harmful-update detection AUC from 0.762 to 0.940 on DoppelVet-Grid and from 0.681 to 0.826 on DoppelVet-Tool, outperforming VaG and AgentDoG 1.5. On DoppelVet-Grid, it reduces trajectories experiencing degradation from 30.39% to 0.43% over a ten-generation self-update loop and leaves no final degradation.
abstract_zh: 自演化智能体通过将反馈保存为可复用的记忆或技能来改进，但一次错误放行可能影响许多后续行为。如果两项更新在验证器看来具有完全相同的证据，却会带来相反的安全结果，验证器就无法仅凭这些证据区分它们。DoppelVet 在候选更新写入智能体的持久状态前进行验证：它无需安全标签，就能构造一项与候选更新在现有验证器所用信号上完全匹配的对照更新；随后从同一状态分别重放两项更新，并交换呈现顺序进行两次行为比较，据此决定是否保留候选更新。实验覆盖 DoppelVet-Grid 中的可执行程序和 DoppelVet-Tool 中的自然语言记忆。在九种开放权重和闭源验证器上，DoppelVet 将两个基准的有害更新检测平均 AUC 分别从 0.762 提升至 0.940、从 0.681 提升至 0.826，优于 VaG 和 AgentDoG 1.5。在 DoppelVet-Grid 的十代自更新实验中，曾出现退化的轨迹比例从 30.39% 降至 0.43%，且实验结束时没有轨迹仍处于退化状态。
key_points_zh: 验证器看到的证据完全相同，并不意味着更新的安全后果相同。
DoppelVet 无需安全标签即可构造信号匹配的对照，从同一状态重放候选和对照更新，并交换呈现顺序比较行为。
跨九种验证器，有害更新检测平均 AUC 在 DoppelVet-Grid 上从 0.762 升至 0.940，在 DoppelVet-Tool 上从 0.681 升至 0.826，均优于 VaG 和 AgentDoG 1.5。
DoppelVet-Grid 上十代自更新期间，曾发生退化的轨迹比例从 30.39% 降至 0.43%，且最终无退化。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 将持久更新的审批从单独检查改为同状态、双顺序的配对回放。九个验证器上的量化比较显示有害更新检测改善，十代循环中出现退化的轨迹比例也下降；未显示验证机制本身会随经验改进。
